## Description {#details}

<p>Writes values as text, as the messages of the checks are written.</p>


<p>Gives access to the plain mode of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/expression-formatter">expression_formatter</a></span>, which is private, so that the names of the test cases generated by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">test_each()</span> show their values as the messages do: the numbers without the type suffixes, and the characters unquoted.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1192 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/expression-formatter-h">expression-formatter.h</a>.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Appends a value to a text, in the plain mode of the formatter.</p>


<p>The text is moved into a local formatter, the value is appended, and the text is moved back, so that no other buffer is allocated.</p>
